responsibility: Coordinates outlives processing at the inference-context level by exposing explicit outlives bounds, resolving accumulated region obligations and constraints into final lexical region solutions, and providing controlled access to collected region constraint data.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the orchestration layer for outlives/region resolution. It extracts explicit outlives bounds, processes registered region obligations, invokes `lexical_region_resolve::resolve`, and exposes APIs to inspect or take constraint data, whereas `region_constraints/mod.rs` is the storage/collection layer and `lexical_region_resolve/mod.rs` is the actual solver.
